verdict.rationale: Better Auth ships an official CLI: it is documented at /docs/concepts/cli, the homepage advertises `npx auth init`, the device-authorization docs say you can test that flow with the Better Auth CLI, and a community user says setup takes one CLI command. The pack shows little of the CLI's actual command set and nothing that makes it agent-friendly. Missing for 10: detailed command reference content (beyond init and device-auth testing), evidence of AI/agent-oriented CLI features such as non-interactive or machine-readable output, independent hands-on corroboration of CLI workflows.
